title: Offscript Brief frontmatter (schemaVersion 1)
description: Machine-readable form of the Offscript Brief Contract (docs/BRIEF-CONTRACT.md). Describes the YAML frontmatter of projects/<client>/references/brief.md. The engine's parser (src/generate/brief.ts) is the authoritative implementation; this artifact lets an external content-engine to brief adapter validate its output before handing off. The brief carries INTENT ONLY — no governance/claims/approval semantics belong here.

schemaVersion.description: Contract major version. Must be in the engine's SUPPORTED_BRIEF_VERSIONS.

track.description: Deliverable track. 'deck' is currently blocked at runtime.

one-liner.description: The single reader-outcome the deliverable must land.

brand.description: Display name. Defaults to the titleized client id when absent.

audience.description: Who arrives, and what they already believe or doubt.

must-include.description: Named sections the deliverable must carry — the job, not a component.

tone.description: Voice / register. Taste only — never colours, sizes, or components.

success-criteria.description: What a successful encounter ends in.

parent_url.description: Parent brand to inherit palette/type/conventions from (Rule 0).

source-doc.description: Path (relative to references/) to long-form grounding copy; the sanctioned channel for an adapter to pass a governed packet body as verbatim copy.

provenance.description: Opaque, audit-only upstream stamp. Recorded verbatim into manifest.json; never interpreted by the engine. All values coerced to strings. Keys are open — an adapter may add any (e.g. sourceSystem, packetId, packetStatus, packetVersion, sourceHash).

$comment: additionalProperties is true because the engine tolerates (and warns on) unknown frontmatter keys for forward-compatibility. An adapter that wants strict output can set this to false locally.
